name: Add Quick Event
description: Create a quick event to the Google Calendar. [See the documentation](https://googleapis.dev/nodejs/googleapis/latest/calendar/classes/Resource$Events.html#quickAdd)

configurable_props.name: calendarId
configurable_props.label: Calendar ID
configurable_props.description: Optionally select the calendar, defaults to the primary calendar for the logged-in user

configurable_props.name: text
configurable_props.label: Describe Event
configurable_props.description: Write a plain text description of event, and Google will parse this string to create the event. eg. 'Meet with Michael 10am 7/22/2024' or 'Call Sarah at 1:30PM on Friday'

configurable_props.name: attendees
configurable_props.label: Attendees
configurable_props.description: Enter either an array or a comma separated list of email addresses of attendees
